title: Studying English After Work
paragraphs: Every evening after dinner, Laila spends thirty minutes practicing English, since she believes it will help her career even though her job does not currently require it directly.

Some nights she feels too tired to focus, but she reminds herself that thirty consistent minutes matter more than one long, exhausting session done occasionally whenever she happens to feel motivated.

Two months into her routine, she catches herself understanding a podcast episode without needing subtitles for the first time, a small moment of progress that motivates her to keep her daily habit going.

After several months of this small, steady habit, Laila notices she can follow English meetings at work much more easily than before. Consistency, she realizes, quietly outperforms motivation that only appears sometimes.
